keyHelp: C - Calibrate : M - Measure : A - Angle : S - Snap to : V,H - line lock : Del - delete : ESC - Clear All : I - inches <-> mm : Tab - Fit
author: Author: K.Davis
aboutParagraph: Microscope MeasureView. A browser-based tool for viewing, calibrating, and measuring microscope images.
usagePara1: - Modes: Use hotkeys (like M for Measure) or the context menu (right-click) to change modes. ESC key whilst in those modes cancels them. C-A-M-Del will delete the in progress measurment in those modes.
usagePara2: - Calibration: Press C, Use a ruler in an image, click two points and enter the known distance. Use ~50% of img width for good cal distance. A saved calibration can be reused for images that use the same object lens and are at the same distance from the lens even if the pixel resolution/aspect ratio is changed.
usagePara3: - In View Mode: (Esc) clears all after confirmation, click near any endpoint to move it. Hover near a line to highlight and grab it's label.
